observations: Original model Sony PlayStation 4 console with a split glossy and matte top cover.
Photo 0 shows the console with a camouflage pattern DualShock 4 controller.
Photo 1 shows the same console with a standard black DualShock 4 controller.
Both photos feature a watermark: 'THE GAME GUY VENTURES'.
The console shows some surface dust and light scratches on the glossy panel.
The 'SONY' and 'PS4' logos are visible on the front of the console.

claims.evidence: No shipping labels or UK-specific power plugs are shown.
Photos 0 and 1 show two different controllers (camouflage and black).

claims.claim: 10 pre-installed games which includes fifa 27, pes 27
claims.evidence: Fifa 27 and PES 27 do not exist; the FIFA series was rebranded to FC in 2023 and PES to eFootball in 2021.
The rear of the console where warranty seals are located is not visible.
No receipt is shown in the provided photos.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and the game launching.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The internal hard drive may be failing.
risks.proof: A video of the system storage settings and smooth UI navigation.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a hard drive replacement

risks.risk: The controller may have analog stick drift or button failure.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being tested in a diagnostic app or gameplay.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the console showing the warranty seals and model number.
Video of the console turned on, showing the library of installed games.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned in the description.
Video of the console connecting to the internet and PSN.
response.reason: The seller claims the console includes games that do not exist (Fifa 27, Pes 27), which is a strong indicator of a scam. Additionally, the photos show two different controllers while the text specifies one, and the images are watermarked by a third party.
